responsibility: Defines BSD-flavored x86 assembler output conventions for GCC, building on AT&T-style operand syntax but changing symbol and pseudo-op policy to match BSD toolchains. This target asm-support header sets label prefixes, skip/common/local emission directives, alignment syntax, internal-label generation, and the leading underscore for user-visible symbols, distinguishing BSD object-format conventions from the generic AT&T header.
